description.en: The ID of the database. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 选用的模型名称，仅可用千问系列
description.en: The name of the selected model. You can use only Qwen series models.

descriptions.zh: 根据用户提供的数据库ID，回答对应引擎的语法问题
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to answer the syntax questions of the corresponding engine according to the specified database ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise answer-sql-syntax-by-meta-agent --db-id 1000 --query '怎么获取当前时间的字符串' --model qwen-plus --region cn-hangzhou
